overview_description.description: Pegasus Intelligence is a UAE-based defence and cybersecurity company specialising in signals intelligence (SIGINT), cyber intelligence (CYBINT), surveillance technologies, and advanced security solutions for government, military, and law enforcement agencies. The company focuses on delivering intelligence-driven capabilities designed for modern C5ISR (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Cyber, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) operations.
